analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of developers.swell.is covered 331 pages with 100% crawl coverage and 91.5% overall confidence. The site contains 10 confirmed broken internal links requiring immediate remediation. API reference coverage is critically low at 31.25% despite 279 API pages detected, indicating significant gaps in usage documentation. SEO/geo issues affect 24.62% of pages, impacting discoverability. Last-updated metadata is present on only 56.5% of pages, limiting transparency on content freshness.
strengths: No repository navigation link breakage detected
Crawl trap detection prevented 9 URLs from skewing results
risks: 10 confirmed broken internal links degrade user experience and SEO authority
API reference coverage at 31.25% leaves 68.75% of API surface undocumented for usage patterns
SEO/geo issues on 24.62% of pages (approximately 81 pages) harm search visibility
43.5% of pages lack last-updated metadata, eroding user trust in content currency
279 API pages detected but low coverage suggests incomplete integration examples or tutorials
Single-product topology may hide cross-product documentation gaps if ecosystem expands
API confidence at 85% indicates potential detection limitations in coverage calculation

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 10 confirmed broken internal links across documentation
Audit 279 API pages and create usage documentation to raise coverage from 31.25% to minimum 70%
Remediate SEO/geo issues on 81 affected pages (24.62% of site)
Add last-updated timestamps to 144 pages currently missing metadata (43.5%)
Implement automated link checking in CI/CD to prevent future broken link accumulation

limitations: External audit cannot verify accuracy or completeness of technical content, code examples, or API specifications
API coverage detection at 85% confidence may undercount or misclassify reference vs. usage documentation
Crawl cannot assess gated content, authentication-required pages, or dynamically generated documentation
SEO/geo issue detection does not guarantee search engine ranking outcomes or international accessibility compliance
Example reliability estimate cannot execute code or validate against live API endpoints
